name: Jeeter | Guava Burst | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Guava Burst brings a tropical aroma with hits of citrus, sour, and a touch of earth. The flavor is just as bold. Sweet and fruity on the dry hit, with tropical citrus on the inhale and a hint of earth on the exhale. It’s a hybrid that tastes like vacation and smokes like a vibe. Spark it up and let the good times roll.
